note: Searched all of app/, config/, deploy/, README and tests for a2a, peer, agent card, webhook, callback and delegate. The only inbound routes are /runs (staff OIDC JWT, main.py:142), /slack/interactions (Slack HMAC from human approvers, main.py:163), /ingest/mail (mail-gateway HMAC carrying vendor documents, ingest.py:104) and /healthz. Mail senders are external vendors, not agents. The extractor is an in-process sub-agent started by the agent itself (extractor.py, budget.py). The ERP MCP is a tool server the agent calls out to, with pinned tools. No route takes messages from another agent, and no peer-supplied callback URLs are fetched. Slack tokens are outbound only.
